name: io.github.codespar/mcp-unblockpay
description: Fiat <> stablecoin cross-border via Customer (KYC mother) → Wallet → Quote → Payin/Payout. Supports BRL Pix, USD wire, EUR SEPA, MXN SPEI on the fiat side and USDC/USDT on Solana/Ethereum/Polygon/Tron on the crypto side.

environment_variables.name: UNBLOCKPAY_BASE_URL
environment_variables.description: Override base URL. Defaults to https://api.unblockpay.com/v1; use https://api.sandbox.unblockpay.com/v1 for sandbox.

tools.name: create_customer
tools.description: Create an individual or business customer (KYC mother). Business customers require date_of_incorporation. Returns { id, status: 'pending', verification: { verification_link } }.

tools.name: list_customers
tools.description: List customers under the operator's API key. `limit` is mandatory per UnblockPay's pagination contract.

tools.name: verify_customer
tools.description: Trigger the KYC verification check for a customer. Idempotent — returns 422 'customer_cannot_be_verified' when already approved.

tools.name: get_verification_details
tools.description: Poll the KYC verification state for a customer. Returns { customer_status, verification_steps[] }.

tools.name: create_wallet
tools.description: Create a stablecoin wallet under an APPROVED customer. blockchain selects the network.

tools.name: list_wallets
tools.description: List wallets under the operator's API key.

tools.name: create_external_account
tools.description: Register a fiat receiver account (BRL Pix, USD wire, EUR SEPA, MXN SPEI). Skippable for BRL Pix payouts.

tools.name: list_external_accounts
tools.description: List external accounts under the operator's API key.

tools.name: create_quote
tools.description: Lock an FX + fee quote for a 5-minute TTL. Same endpoint for on_ramp (fiat → stablecoin) and off_ramp (stablecoin → fiat).

tools.name: create_payin
tools.description: Create a fiat → stablecoin pay-in referencing a quote_id. Sandbox min: 150 BRL.

tools.name: create_payout
tools.description: Create a stablecoin → fiat payout referencing a quote_id. Pix-BR shortcut: pass receiver.pix_key + document directly.

tools.name: get_transaction
tools.description: Poll transaction status. Lifecycle: awaiting_deposit → processing → completed (or failed / refunded / cancelled).

tools.name: cancel_transaction
tools.description: Cancel a transaction. Only valid while status is 'awaiting_deposit'.
